svg.text: ECB inflation panel, 2000–2025: green = the outcome landed inside their range
One row per anonymous ECB forecaster (64 of them, sorted best at the top), one column per year. Each said where euro-area
inflation would land with 80% confidence. Green = it did. Red = it did not. Grey = not on the panel that year.
The columns are the story: in 2008, and again through 2021–2023, not one of the 64 was inside the range they themselves had published.
The rows are the other story: some are green far more often than others — but the best of them still quotes a wider range.
Data: ECB Survey of Professional Forecasters, individual responses, one-year-ahead (Q4 round of the year before) vs euro-area HICP, 10+ scored years each.
Forecasters are anonymous; the ECB publishes them only by number. · method and every number: namikakmandev.github.io/ecb-forecaster-skill.html
